== English Special Edition comparison ==
The printed Effect title ends in an exclamation point and has no uniqueness dot. The December 2016 Players Committee announcement removed the punctuation and made the Effect unique, matching the title and uniqueness of the separately printed Defensive Shield. The Effect's game text stayed the same.
